original.description: A brigadier of the 1st Regiment of Chasseurs d’Afrique with his horse, photographed on the Marne in 1914. An autochrome by Jules Gervais-Courtellemont — the Commons record states explicitly that this is an autochrome and not a colorized picture.
original.archive: Bibliothèque nationale de France; digitised on Gallica, via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; UsageTerms "Public domain"). Credit line on the record: Gallica Digital Library.

colorization.status: not colorized, and must not be — this is an original colour photograph (autochrome). Reproduce as it is; any colour change would falsify a documentary colour record.

content_policy: ok — a cavalryman and his horse, no gore
caption: A brigadier of the 1st Chasseurs d’Afrique on the Marne, 1914. An autochrome by Jules Gervais-Courtellemont: real colour, exposed at the time, not added afterwards.
credit: Original photograph: Jules Gervais-Courtellemont, 1914; Bibliothèque nationale de France, via Gallica and Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. The most valuable single item in this shot list: a documentary colour photograph of a French soldier in September 1914. It should be shown beside a project colorization somewhere in the UI so a reader can see the difference between colour that was recorded and colour that was inferred (ADR 0007). MUST NOT be recolorized or "corrected".
